title: TestConnectionRequest
description: Parameters for providers.testConnection. Tests whatever is currently in the provider form, saved or not: providerType is the only required field, so the key and endpoint can be checked before a model name is settled on. id names an existing profile, so a blank apiKey falls back to its stored key and a successful test can cache the model suggestions on it; absent, apiKey is required, exactly as an unsaved provider has no stored key to fall back to.

id.description: Identifier of an existing profile. Absent when testing a provider that has not been saved yet.

providerType.description: Which provider family to test against. The values match ProviderType on the outbound side.

model.description: Model identifier to verify against the models the key can reach. Absent skips verification; the key and endpoint are still tested.

baseUrl.description: Endpoint override, exactly as providers.save accepts it. Required for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, optional elsewhere.

apiKey.description: The credential to test. Required unless id names a profile with a key already stored, in which case an absent value tests that stored key.
